name: Kutná Hora: The City of Silver

source.title: Kutná Hora rulebook, third-party copy of the publisher file

setup.text: Set out the rounds track on the side for your player count and put the rounds counter on its first space.
Put the tax counter on 0 of the tax track.
Stack the 3 red patrician buildings on the marked square of the rounds track.

Sort the guild buildings into 6 stacks by colour. Shuffle the 6 corner-marked tiles and deal them to the six spaces in the two leftmost columns of the town hall board, then stack the other 3 tiles of each colour on its matching tile in random order.
Shuffle the green, silver and yellow patrician buildings into three stacks and place each at the end of its row.
Assemble the Kutná Hora board on the side for your player count.

by_count.2: Use the side with fewer squares.
by_count.3: Use the side with more squares.
by_count.4: Use the side with more squares.

setup.text: Draw one mine setup card. Shuffle the rock tiles face down, deal them to the spaces the card shows, then turn them face up.
Stand the population deck (0–19) and ore deck (0–14) in their card stands, in number order, with the indicator arms on the left.
Build St. Barbara's Cathedral from its 11 tiles: 1–5 at the bottom, 6–10 in the middle, 11 on top.
Make a bank of coins, pelican tokens and exactly 3 patrician tokens of each colour.
Stack the 4 mining technology tiles face down in order with tile 1 on top.
Shuffle the mine tiles by their backs and make one stack: I on top, II in the middle, III at the bottom. Put it on the prospecting board, leaving a space for discards.
Deal one event face down above each round space except the last: A events before the red patrician stack, B events after it.
Take the pieces in your colour: 3 plot markers, 12 house tokens, 6 action cards, 1 miner in your pool and 8 more in reserve.
Put 4 production markers on 0, your reputation marker on 0 and your score counter on 0.
Give the starting player marker to whoever was most recently underground, or choose at random.
Take starting groschen by turn order: 40 for the first player, then 41, 42 and 43.
Draw a guild setup card and use the row for your player count. Players choose a set of 3 guilds in reverse turn order. For a first game use card 1.

turn.summary: Play action cards from your hand of six. Each card shows two actions and you use one of them.
steps: On your first and second turns of a round, play 2 cards.
On your third turn, play 1 card. One card always goes unused.
A played card is out for the rest of the round, including the action you did not choose.

round_end: The round ends when everyone has taken 3 turns.
Each player pays taxes or takes a reputation penalty.
end: The game ends after the last round on the rounds track.

scoring.text: City: for each building, its owner scores 1 point for every matching dot on an adjacent building or board edge.

Mines: each row is worth more the more stars it holds. Players score by rank of stars in the row; players with no stars score nothing. Tied players each get the full value of the place and the next place is skipped.
Income: divide your final income by 10, round down, and score that many points.

missed.text: Starting money differs by seat: each later player gets 1 more groschen.
Event cards are used only with two players.

unverified: The mine tile stacking order (I, II, III) is shown with icons in the rulebook and was inferred from a later sentence.
not_covered: What each action card does is not summarised yet.
Final scoring may include more than the three categories listed.
